definitions.pairing: key = STAGE:EPISODE_sSEED; 14 H + 5 B pairs; d = V11AB - V8
definitions.crossing_row: carry crossing row of the measured apple centre: first row t >= first in-hand row with s(t-1) < 0 <= s(t), s = signed horizontal distance of the apple centre across the bar's vertical plane (+ toward the crate), post state of row t (xm_cross crossing_rows apple_M carry). C variant: same on the commanded state (apple_C).
definitions.crossing_window: rows with min over groups (fingers, palm, apple in hand) of min(geo C, geo M) to the hurdle <= 100 mm (xm_cross in_window, HX rule)
definitions.deflection_onset_rows: crossing_row - t_first, t_first = first EXECUTED control row t with first_inhand_t <= t < crossing_row whose chunk-step palm |refined - reference| (EE_BODY origin, FK at the planning-row state, row k of its chunk) > 5 mm. None if no such row. Variants: _from_t0 (search from row 0), _contiguous (start of the run of consecutive executed deflected rows that contains crossing_row - 1; 0 if crossing_row - 1 not deflected).
definitions.lift_hold_rows: length of the maximal run of consecutive control rows, each EXECUTED and with commanded apple-bottom height above the policy reference by > 5 mm (apple_bottom(refined row k) - apple_bottom(reference row k), apple rigid with EE_BODY at the planning-row state, in hand at that state), that contains the crossing row; 0 if the crossing row is not such a row. Also rows of that run before / after the crossing row, and lifted executed rows inside the crossing window.
definitions.acc_jerk: TCP = site <side>_ee. commanded C(t) = executed_actions[t] (both arms) on the post state of row t; measured M(t) = post state of row t (recorded qpos of row t+1). a(t) = |p(t+1) - 2p(t) + p(t-1)| * 15^2 (m/s^2); j(t) = |p(t+1) - 3p(t) + 3p(t-1) - p(t-2)| * 15^3 (m/s^3). A stencil is used only when all its rows are executed. boundary = stencil rows belong to >= 2 chunks (chunk_seq); inner = otherwise. window_in / window_out = stencil centre row t in / not in the crossing window (H); window_in_carry = window_in and carry (V8 runs that stopped on the return have no return-window rows). carry = centre row in [grasp_t, release_t]. Per run: median, p90, max of each class; paired tests on the per-run value.
definitions.success: old = analysis success (analyze_e0: grasp = planning-row apple z >= z0 + 50 mm; place = apple centre in the crate box at the last planning row). Z4 = success_rel (release_t exists, separation kept, apple in crate at the end). CT = old and Z4 and no robot/apple-hurdle contact row at or before release_t (B: no obstacle -> CT = old and Z4).
definitions.collision: H replay obstacle_contact_rows (MuJoCo contacts, any sub-step, incl. margin contacts as in CT) with the hurdle collision geoms; robot = hand (palm + both fingers of the active arm) or robot_other; apple = apple geom. Phases: before_grasp t < grasp_t; carry grasp_t <= t <= release_t (Z4 release_t; none -> to the end); return t > release_t. run flag = >= 1 contact row in the phase; row share = contact rows / rows of the phase.
definitions.min_clearance_M: analysis hurdle series (mj_geomDistance / client pair_distance on the recorded qpos, capped 300 mm, signed; per control row): fingers = Af (both fingers of the active arm), palm = Ae (EE_BODY), robot_other = C; min over all rows; apple = B over carry rows grasp_t..release_t (Z4; none -> to the end).
definitions.safety_violation: plan C: executed rows of crossing-window chunks whose TO-row reconstruction of the refined row (xm_cross to_ref[k].min_mm = min over all field queries of d - r - margin, 10 mm obstacle margin, held rows margin 0) < 0, share of executed rows of window chunks. measured M: rows whose post-state measured hurdle distance (analysis series at index t+1: min(Af, Ae, C), and B while t in carry) < 10 mm; share of all rows and of crossing-window rows. verdict violated share = server to_status 'violated' chunks / server chunks; HOLD share = HOLD chunks / planning rows.
definitions.grasp_retention: grasp (old) and Z4 release_t exists and apple centre over the crate xy box at release (in_crate_xy_at_release); no grasp -> false. held_to_end = grasp and no release_t (apple still in hand when the run ended).
definitions.slip: replay, state indices from attach_t (first server chunk with attach_now; else grasp_t) to the post state of row release_t - 1 (Y2 window, only with release_t). finger-midpoint: |R_tcp^T(apple - finger_mid)(i) - (same)(attach)|; Y2 TCP: |R_tcp^T(apple - tcp)(i) - (same)(attach)| (y_metrics). max over the window and the value at its last state (just before release). pre_open variant (finger-midpoint): window end = state index of min(release_t, applied_open_t) (post state of the row before the gripper-open command row, or Y2 end if earlier) — the Y2 last state already contains the opening on open_cmd releases.
definitions.path_length: measured, post states, rows grasp_t .. release_t (Z4; both must exist): apple centre path, TCP path (and commanded TCP path), sum of |p(t+1) - p(t)| (mm); window part = steps whose two rows are both in the crossing window (H).
definitions.execution_time: rows (and s = rows / 15): grasp_t (old), crossing_row (H), release_t (Z4), place_t (old); durations release - grasp, crossing - grasp.
definitions.latency_server: server-recorded TO solve_ms per chunk, first chunk of each run excluded; per run median / p90; pod load1 mean during the run (load samples between .start and .end).
definitions.latency_controlled: T43 TP tp_timing (server mode, same V8 chunks, configs rotated in one process): wall_ms per chunk for variants V8 and V11AB, first chunk excluded; per run median / p90; field cuda (= server path) and cpu.
